```{r, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
# plotly.js from the CDN, so the site's pages don't each copy it
options(plotly.core.plotlyjs = "cdn")
```

This page is not available for plotly.core yet: all of its examples are `ggplot2` graphs converted with `ggplotly()`. See the [histograms](histograms.html) page for histograms built with `add_histogram()`.
